description: Holds branch review scheme influencer monthly records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review scheme influencer monthly records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review scheme influencer monthly.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review scheme influencer monthly.
columns.business_meaning: Branch Review Scheme Influencer Monthly identifier

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review scheme influencer monthly.

columns.name: scheme_influencer_detail_id
columns.description: Scheme influencer detail id of the branch review scheme influencer monthly.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year of the branch review scheme influencer monthly.

columns.name: qty
columns.description: Qty of the branch review scheme influencer monthly.

columns.name: visits
columns.description: Visits of the branch review scheme influencer monthly.

relationships.description: Each branch review scheme influencer monthly references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Use qty for monetary or quantity totals.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Qty per branch review scheme influencer monthly

common_queries: Branch Review Scheme Influencer Monthly by branch review header
Top branch review header by qty

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewSchemeInfluencerMonthly (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review scheme influencer monthly records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(qty) for totals of qty.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
